messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Malayalam, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Malayalam line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
ഞാൻ അത് എങ്ങനെ പ്രവേശിച്ചതെന്ന് നന്നായി പറയാൻ കഴിയില്ല, അന്നത്തെ നിമിഷത്തിൽ ഞാൻ ഉറക്കത്തിൽ അതിയായ നിറവുണ്ടായിരുന്നു അവിടെ ഞാൻ സത്യമായ വഴിയെ ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചു.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table (Source → Malayalam)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase (Malayalam) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | Io | 1st‑person singular pronoun, subject | ഞാൻ | I | OK | | non | Negation particle (‑not) | — (merged in *കഴിയില്ല*) | — | UNNECESSARY | | so | Verb *sapere* “to know” (used with *non* → “cannot”) | — (merged in *കഴിയില്ല*) | — | UNNECESSARY | | ben | Manner adverb “well” | നന്നായി | well | OK | | ridir | Infinitive “recount, tell again” | പറയാൻ | to say / to recount | OK | | com' | Interrogative adverb “how” | എങ്ങനെ | how | OK | | i' | Clitic pronoun “I” (re‑iteration) | — (subject already expressed by *ഞാൻ*) | — | UNNECESSARY | | v'intrai | Past historic “I entered it” | പ്രവേശിച്ചതെന്ന് | (that) I entered | OK | | tant' | Degree adverb “so, such a great” | അതിയായ | so great | OK | | era | Imperfect “was” (copular) | ഉണ്ടായിരുന്നു | was | OK | | pien | Predicative adjective “full” | നിറവുണ്ടായിരുന്നു | was full | OK | | di | Preposition “of” (linking *pien* to *sonno*) | — (merged in *ഉറക്കത്തിൽ*) | — | UNNECESSARY | | sonno | Noun “slumber, sleepiness” | ഉറക്കത്തിൽ | in sleep | OK | | a | Temporal preposition “at” | — (merged in *നിമിഷത്തിൽ*) | — | UNNECESSARY | | quel | Demonstrative “that” | അന്നത്തെ | that (moment) | OK | | punto | Noun “point, moment” | നിമിഷത്തിൽ | at the moment | OK | | che | Relative conjunction “where” | അവിടെ | there / where | OK | | la | Definite article “the” (feminine) | — (articles omitted in Malayalam) | — | UNNECESSARY | | verace | Adjective “true, genuine” | സത്യമായ | true | OK | | via | Noun “way, path” (ACC) | വഴിയെ | the way (accusative) | OK | | abbandonai | Past historic “I abandoned” | ഉപേക്ഷിച്ചു | abandoned | OK |
### Items flagged
- **UNNECESSARY** (source words not required as separate tokens in Malayalam): `non`, `so`, `i'`, `di`, `a`, `la`. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Malayalam script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Malayalam text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
